workarounds.symptom: Next.js 15+ changed 'params' and 'searchParams' in page/layout/route handlers from synchronous objects to Promises. Sync access throws runtime Error: Route params should be awaited.
workarounds.workaround: Update handler signature: 'export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { const { id } = await params; }'.
